description: This file defines a progress provider and controller for a Flutter app using Riverpod state management. It manages progress data related to lessons, including fetching, updating completion status, scoring, and current step. It imports models, repositories, and providers to handle progress data, intended for the front-end logic handling user progress in lessons.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: A Riverpod Notifier that manages user progress state, allowing updates to completion status, score, and current lesson step.

methods.name: ProgressController.build
methods.description: Initializes the progress state, attempting to load existing progress for the selected lesson.

methods.name: ProgressController.markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the current lesson as completed and updates the repository.

methods.name: ProgressController.updateScore
methods.description: Updates the score for the current lesson progress.

methods.name: ProgressController.updateStep
methods.description: Updates the current step index within the lesson progress.
